name: Lamar Wise
occupation: State Representative; Project Director, Oregon AFSCME

bio.statement: A Multnomah County release dated November 5, 2025 says Wise was appointed to House District 48 and describes Wise as political director for Oregon Council 75 of AFSCME.
bio.excerpt: political director for Oregon Council 75 of the American Federation of State, County and Municipal Employees

source.publisher: Multnomah County news release

verification.note: Reworded as attributed to the release; the legislature biography uses a different title (Political Coordinator), so 'is political director' was not stated as current fact.

bio.statement: The Oregon Capital Chronicle described Wise at the appointment as former executive director of the Oregon Student Association.
bio.excerpt: former executive director of the Oregon Student Association

source.publisher: Oregon Capital Chronicle

verification.note: Statement also asserted 'former political director of the state AFSCME union', which is not in the excerpt; trimmed.

bio.statement: OPB, republishing the Oregon Capital Chronicle, reports the state ethics commission voted 8-0 to open a full investigation after an August complaint alleged Wise did not disclose income from the nonprofit Seeding Justice.
bio.excerpt: commissioners during a Friday executive session voted 8-0 to open a full investigation into Rep. Lamar Wise, D-Portland, after a complaint in August alleged that Wise failed to disclose income from Seeding Justice, a Portland-based social justice nonprofit.

source.publisher: OPB (Oregon Capital Chronicle)

verification.note: Ethics item kept. Excerpt extended (contiguous on the page) so the allegation is stated in the cited text rather than added in the paraphrase; wording is attributed ('alleged'), neutral, and paired with Wise's response in b4. Published 2026-10-12/13 (byline Shaanth Nanguneri, Oregon Capital Chronicle).

bio.statement: In the same report, Wise says they are working with the Ethics Commission to resolve what they call an honest mistake and expect it to be resolved soon.
bio.excerpt: the Ethics Commission to resolve this honest mistake, and expect it to be resolved soon

source.publisher: OPB (Oregon Capital Chronicle)

verification.note: Statement claimed he amended his form and called it an omission; those words are outside the excerpt. Excerpt extended to the contiguous phrase and statement limited to it. Paired with b3 as the candidate's response.
